messages:
jamie (partnerships): Heads up: Nimbus and Redwood doing a joint perf/W sweep next week. Need quick alignment on measurement windows and deliverables.
minh (eng-runtime): ok. Who's owning the run orchestration and CSV schema?
alex (NimbusCore HW): Nimbus will provide 4 test nodes, per-node power telemetry, and a kibana dashboard. We can also supply a kernel with our prefetch patch for one arm of the comparison. Link to spec: https://nimbuscore.example.com/specs/bench-telemetry
sofia (eng-ml): For model coverage let's pick one small (7B) and one mid (13B). Capture seq 512 and 1024, batch 1/4, and q4_0 + q8_1. Also collect quality samples (25 prompts each).
minh (eng-runtime): I'll wire up the runner. Measurement plan: 2 warmup minutes, 5 measurement minutes per config, power sampled at 5Hz. That yields steady-state tokens/sec and average power.
jamie (partnerships): Marketplace blurb needs: tokens/sec per watt (sustained) and 99p latency at target throughput. We should include a short method note.
alex (NimbusCore HW): Agree. We prefer tests during our lab hours M-F 09:00-17:00 PT. Also we need kernel logs to go to s3://nimbus-private/debug for the prefetch runs. Ticket #INFRA-402 opened.
minh (eng-runtime): draft run cmd (WIP):
```
./run_bench --model llm-13b --seq 1024 --batch 4 --quant q8_1 --kernel stock \n  --duration 300 --power-sample 5 --out redwood_nimbus_run.csv --promptset eval_v1.json
```
sofia (eng-ml): please add --eval-output so we can attach generated outputs for regression checks.
infra-bot: CI job created: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/nimbus-sweep (dry-run nightly).
jamie (partnerships): action list: @minh runner + CSV + CI, @sofia promptset + eval harness, @alex provision nodes + telemetry + s3 path, partnerships will draft the marketplace text.
minh (eng-runtime): I'll post the PR with the CSV schema and a small parser today.
alex (NimbusCore HW): Boards ship tomorrow ETA 36h. Will ping when racked and networked.
sofia (eng-ml): I'll upload 25-prompt packs and baseline outputs by EOD tomorrow.
jamie (partnerships): Let's reconvene Thursday 11am PT to review first dry-run. I'll send calendar invite. :thumbsup:
